'''2010 Worlds Day 2 Bill Kafer LS Yavin 4 Massassi Throne Room''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Bill Kafer]] at [[2010 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name on sheet: Uncle Wiggily's Revenge.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room]]
* '''Username:''' TacoBill
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
